title: Question Bank
subtitle: Banks, folders and the questions exams are built from

math.hint: Write the equation with the symbol keyboard, then press Add to place it at the cursor.

font.followsPassage: Passage questions use the passage's font.

smartPaste.title: Paste a ready question
smartPaste.description: Paste the question and its options from Word or a PDF; each part goes to its own field. An answer underlined in Word is marked correct, or put * after it to mark it. If you paste the question alone with no options, it is an essay question.
smartPaste.placeholder:
Example:
What is the capital of Egypt?
a) Cairo *
b) Alexandria
c) Aswan
smartPaste.question: Question

editor.stemHint: Text, an image, an audio file, or any of them together.
editor.multiHint: Mark every correct answer (at least two). Students see that the question has more than one answer.
editor.matchingIntro: Each item in the first column pairs with an item in the second. Items left without a pair are decoys.
editor.matchingHint: Correct pairs: {{count}}. The question's mark in an exam is its number of pairs.
editor.modelAnswerHint: Text or an image; students see it after grading.
editor.explanationHint: Students see it after the exam ends.
editor.perOptionHint: Write each option's explanation under it in the options section.
editor.optionLabelHint: Shown to students instead of the numbering. Only for numbered shapes in the question image.

bank.empty: No banks yet. Start with a bank for each subject.
bank.subject: Subject
bank.archiveConfirm: Archive the bank "{{name}}" with everything in it? You can restore it from the archive.
bank.copyStarted: Copying the bank; it will be ready in a moment
bank.copyingHint: This bank is being filled with the copied content. Nothing can be added until it is done.
bank.copyFailedHint: Copying this bank failed. Archive it and copy the original bank again.

folder.emptyHint: This folder is empty. Add folders, questions, or both.
folder.levelsHint: They apply to everything in the folder. With none picked, the folder takes its parent's years.
folder.archiveConfirm: Archive the folder "{{name}}" with everything in it? You can restore it from the archive.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: This bank's categories and subcategories, used in question draw rules.
categories.deleteConfirm: Delete the category "{{name}}"? Its questions stay, without a category.

copy.title: Copy {{count}} questions
copy.description: Pick the folder to copy into. Each copy is independent with a new serial.

archive.title: Archive
archive.description: Everything archived from the bank. Restoring puts it back where it was.

question.empty: No questions in this folder yet.
question.archiveConfirm: Archive {{count}} questions? You can restore them from the archive.
question.pasteHint: Paste a ready question here (Ctrl+V) to open a new question with its text and options filled in. Underlined answers are marked correct: one means multiple choice, more than one means multiple answers, two options only means true/false, and the question alone with no options means an essay question. Or paste a picture to use it as the question image.

passage.empty: No questions under this passage yet.

filters.noReorder: Drag to reorder only without filters.
